sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 19049 of 2023

Applicant :- Akash Singh Baghel
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Suneel Kumar Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Love Lesh Kumar Verma,R P Rajan
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A., Sri R.P. Rajan, learned counsel for the informant and perused the record.
2.
The FIR in question was lodged alleging the commission of an offence under Section 376 IPC on the false pretext of marriage.
3. An affidavit has been filed that the applicant and the victim has decided to marry now.
The said affidavit is taken on record.
4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

entities.text: Akash Singh Baghel vs State Of U.P. on 17 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of the subsequent development coupled with the fact that applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 3.01.2023 and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
6. Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Akash Singh Baghel be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 22 of 2023,
under Sections 376, 504, 506 IPC, P.S. Chitaipur, District Varanasi, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs. 25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 17.8.2023 S.A.
